result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-round payment processor**, but if you're based in Australia, there are a few particularly good options worth comparing.

My recommendations for an Australian small business in 2026\:

## Top 5 payment processors

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy integration with most online stores.
- Supports cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Excellent reporting and fraud protection.
- Australian domestic cards: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple setup and reconciliation.
- Supports digital wallets.
- No separate third-party payment gateway required.

[Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**
Best if you sell online and in person.

- Straightforward pricing.
- Good inventory and sales management.
- Integrates online and physical sales.

[Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**
Best as an additional payment option.

- Customers recognise and trust it.
- Offers PayPal wallet payments.
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms.
- Can have higher transaction fees.

[PayPal Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Airwallex**
Best for international sales.

- Competitive domestic card fees.
- Multi-currency accounts.
- Useful for overseas suppliers and customers.
- Good international payment infrastructure.

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

Indicative Australian pricing and feature comparisons; actual fees depend on plan, card type and transaction circumstances. ## What would I choose?

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online store | Stripe |
| Already using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Selling online and face-to-face | Square |
| Selling internationally | Airwallex |
| Want customers to have more payment choices | Add PayPal |
